name: The Goblin's Brides
source:
It's a fantasy game where you play as a young woman named Yharnam and her two companions, Morgana and Nax, on their journey home after an unsuccessful mission.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/GoblinBrides]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一部奇幻游戏。你将扮演年轻女性雅南，以及她的两位同伴摩根娜与纳克斯，在一次任务失败后，踏上归乡之路。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/GoblinBrides]Patreon[/url]]
